fieldValues.title: publication-reachability exclusions: express a permanent disposition
fieldValues.summary: 80 of 82 scripts/publication-reachability-exclusions.json entries cite a closed GitHub issue; the schema had no way to say a closed-issue citation is a settled ruling rather than a regression. Added a required disposition (permanent | pending) field, validated in check-publication-reachability.mjs, and reclassified all 82 entries.
